# Outlier Weekly

Outlier Weekly is Cemini23's weekly letter on investing and AI. One subject
per issue. The desk also writes operator notes on Atto paperwork and
GuruWatcher Discord alerts. Early issues priced rare-event markets on
Polymarket and Kalshi. This domain hosts the owned hub pages; the letters
themselves live on Substack.

## Claim fence

Not financial advice. Not affiliated with Outlier AI, Outlier.com, or
Outlier.org. Atto is not a law firm and does not decide eligibility.
GuruWatcher is alert-only and never places orders.
SPCX / Anthropic is research commentary, not a recommendation to buy
or sell SpaceX, Tesla, or Anthropic paper.
The parlay letter is one graded Sunday, not an edge and not a wager.
Tanbreez and tungsten letters are not ticker recommendations.
The rearmament letter names eight companies as the place the growth sits.
It is not a recommendation to buy or sell any of them, and the FY2027
figures are a budget request, not an appropriation.
The Swarmer letter explains one company's revenue mechanics. It is not
a recommendation to buy or sell Swarmer (NASDAQ: SWMR) or Ratel Robotics,
and the Ratel deal has not closed.
The Voyager letter is not a recommendation to buy or sell Voyager Technologies stock or its convertible notes.
